description.value: SummerGate Winery is a family-run organic estate winery established in 2009 by the Stohler family, producing 100% BC wine from certified-organic grapes grown on their own Prairie Valley property in Summerland. Located along Summerland's Bottleneck Drive wine route, the property features a family- and pet-friendly licensed patio with picnic area, a weekend kitchen with food service including Sunday waffle breakfasts, and wine tastings of their specialty white, rosé, and frizzante-style wines. It is a natural and convivial rest stop on one of the Okanagan's most popular cycling corridors.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: SummerGate Winery is an active, visitor-facing estate winery on Summerland's Bottleneck Drive with a licensed patio, picnic area, and weekend food service — a strong and appealing stop for touring cyclists on this well-travelled Okanagan wine-route corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The winery skipped a 2024 vintage due to a cold snap and instead expanded patio/events offerings; the 2025 and 2026 seasons are fully operational with seven new 2025-vintage releases available.
